text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So C.B.'s really sitting out the whole spring season, huh...
Feels like the Senior Class is missing its main star...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Did you see Symboli Rudolf in the Yayoi Sho?!
She's insanely strong after all~!
She's seriously gonna sweep the Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Good grief, I can't help feeling like the mood across the entire venue is kind of uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I've got a pretty good idea what caused it, though.
choice_data_list: Let's seize the momentum starting with this race today.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, you're right.
That's what today's Osaka Hai is for, after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win right here
and shout to the world that I'm here!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the sound of a high-five pledging victory,
I sent Katsuragi Ace off with full confidence—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —It should be just about time for the Osaka Hai to start.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aah, I wanted to run too~.
